title: The agent-environment loop and Monte Carlo values
brief: Run episodes in a small grid room, turn their rewards into discounted returns, and estimate a policy's value by averaging, checked against the exact answer.
hints: Loop over the rewards backward: running = rewards[t] + gamma * running, then store running at index t. One pass, no nested sum.

rng.choice(mdp.n_actions, p=pi[s]) draws one action with the policy's probabilities.
